metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee CrossDex is a routing helper used by Coffee Swap integrations to forward swaps through external TON DEX flows."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee CrossDex routing helper with the Bidask native-transfer callback."

metadata.author: "Coffee Swap"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Factory is the DEX registry and deployment hub that creates vaults, pools, and helper contracts for Coffee Swap markets."

metadata.author: "Coffee Swap"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Init is the bootstrap contract users may see while the factory prepares a newly deployed Coffee Swap component."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Liquidity Depository is a short-lived escrow helper that holds assets while a user's liquidity deposit is finalized."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap LP Jetton Wallet is a user's LP token account, holding pool-share tokens and handling LP transfers or burns."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee MEV Protector holds swap intents and releases or fails them to reduce harmful execution around Coffee trades."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Historical Coffee MEV Protector that holds swap intents and routes failed swaps back to recipients."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Constant-Product Pool is a liquidity pool for volatile asset pairs where users swap tokens and LPs earn fees."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Pool Creator is a short-lived escrow helper that holds initial assets while the factory creates a new pool."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Curve.fi Stable Pool is a liquidity pool tuned for stable asset pairs where users swap with lower slippage."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Staking Item is an NFT position that represents one user's locked stake, unlock time, and reward participation."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Staking Master manages a staking program where users lock tokens, receive staking NFTs, and earn configured rewards."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Staking Vault receives users' staking tokens and coordinates locks with the staking master and position NFTs."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Extra-Currency Vault is the vault for non-jetton extra-currency assets used in Coffee Swap swaps, liquidity, and payouts."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Jetton Vault receives users' jettons for swaps, liquidity deposits, pool creation, and payouts."

metadata.author: "swap.coffee"
metadata.description: "Coffee Swap Native Vault is the GRAM vault users interact with when swapping, adding liquidity, or receiving native payouts on Coffee Swap."
